geometry.change: Move the thumb to the RIGHT end of the track (value = now) and re-point the 'Previewing …' label at the newest entry. The timeline then runs BACK from the present.
geometry.why: TimeTravelScrubber.tsx:74-78 seeds `initialIndex = Math.floor(historyStack.length / 2)` and `sliderValue` from it, so the drawer opens with an arbitrary past moment ARMED. Combined with the Enter default (UX-I-03) and the invisible preview (UX-I-12) the default position is both meaningless and dangerous. Open at the current state, so the first thing the user sees matches the canvas.
readBack: the preview label names the newest entry, not a mid-stack one

geometry.change: Panel-side half only: the drawer band states that time-travel is a MODE and that the canvas is not editable while it is on — 'Time-travel is on. The canvas is read-only; ← → step the timeline.'
geometry.why: TimeTravelScrubber.tsx:271-275 registers ArrowLeft/ArrowRight on the document with no defaultPrevented test, while useCanvasKeyboard.ts:78 checks defaultPrevented and :280-300 claims the same keys for selection and 1px/10px nudges. The canvas handler runs first (React root) and calls preventDefault, so ONE arrow press both walks the element selection AND steps the timeline. The canvas stays fully interactive because the overlay layer is pointer-events:none (TimeTravelScrubber.tsx:178; history.css:914-926) and the preview layer sits at opacity 0 when it has no snapshot.
geometry.notCovered: The canvas half of the fix — the canvas visibly non-editable, with the mode said ON the canvas where the user's attention is — has no board in this section. Every History board here is a 280/360-wide panel board; there is no full-screen History board that draws the canvas under an open drawer. Owner: 1779:5 '09 · Canvas' and 1776:8385 '01 · Shell'. NOT applied by this module.

geometry.why: history.css:928-934 sets .tt-drawer { left: var(--bk-space-48); right: 320px; height: 200px }, so ~232px of the drawer — including the start-of-range timestamp — sits under the 280px (700px expanded) History panel that opened it, and the right inset assumes an inspector that is always exactly 320px and always present.
geometry.reason: 163:113 is a PANEL-width board. It does not draw the drawer's position relative to the canvas, the panel or the inspector, so there is no geometry on it that can be wrong in the way the finding describes. Carrying the finding here would mean inventing a full-screen History board, duplicating the shell family in 1776:8385. Filed as a shell-section item instead; NOT applied anywhere by this module.
